avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing felbamate levels and efficacy; may precipitate seizures
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on seizure risk if discontinuing felbamate

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 metabolism; potential reduction in felbamate concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor seizure control; consider alternative supplement or felbamate level monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive CNS depression; may enhance sedation
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient of increased sedation risk; use lowest effective doses

caution_supplements.name: Kava Kava
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; assess liver function if combined use necessary

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase felbamate plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption or monitor for adverse effects (dizziness, ataxia, diplopia)

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay absorption and alter peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Administer felbamate consistently with or without food for stable levels

monitoring_notes: Monitor for hepatotoxicity and bone marrow suppression as per FDA black box warning; periodic liver function tests and CBC are recommended. Therapeutic drug monitoring may be warranted given CYP450 enzyme interactions and narrow therapeutic index.
